#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::string str;
    std::cin.ignore(); // To consume the newline after the integer input
    std::getline(std::cin, str);
    str += "_";

    bool inside_paren = false, inside_word = false;
    int total_words = 0, current_word_length = 0, max_word_length = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        char c = str[i];
        if (inside_word && (c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')')) {
            inside_word = false;
            if (inside_paren) {
                total_words++;
            } else if (current_word_length > max_word_length) {
                max_word_length = current_word_length;
            }
            if (c == '(') {
                inside_paren = true;
            }
            if (c == ')') {
                inside_paren = false;
            }
            current_word_length = 0;
        } else if (!inside_word && !(c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')')) {
            inside_word = true;
            current_word_length++;
        } else if (inside_word) {
            current_word_length++;
        } else {
            if (c == '(') {
                inside_paren = true;
            } else if (c == ')') {
                inside_paren = false;
            }
        }
    }
    std::cout << max_word_length << " " << total_words;
    return 0;
}
